title: Disrupting prostate cancer research: Challenge accepted; report from the 2023 Coffey-Holden Prostate Cancer Academy Meeting.
authors: Miyahira, Andrea K; Kamran, Sophia C; Jamaspishvili, Tamara; Marshall, Catherine H; Maxwell, Kara N; Parolia, Abhijit; Zorko, Nicholas A; Pienta, Kenneth J; Soule, Howard R
one_liner_zh: 该文是2023年前列腺癌学术会议报告，虽提及转录因子和AI精准医疗，但以临床和综述为主，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法的具体研究。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: The 2023 Coffey-Holden Prostate Cancer Academy (CHPCA) Meeting, themed "Disrupting Prostate Cancer Research: Challenge Accepted," was convened at the University of California, Los Angeles, Luskin Conference Center, in Los Angeles, CA, from June 22 to 25, 2023. METHODS: The 2023 marked the 10th Annual CHPCA Meeting, a discussion-oriented scientific think-tank conference convened annually by the Prostate Cancer Foundation, which centers on innovative and emerging research topics deemed pivotal for advancing critical unmet needs in prostate cancer research and clinical care. The 2023 CHPCA Meeting was attended by 81 academic investigators and included 40 talks across 8 sessions. RESULTS: The central topic areas covered at the meeting included: targeting transcription factor neo-enhancesomes in cancer, AR as a pro-differentiation and oncogenic transcription factor, why few are cured with androgen deprivation therapy and how to change dogma to cure metastatic prostate cancer without castration, reducing prostate cancer morbidity and mortality with genetics, opportunities for radiation to enhance therapeutic benefit in oligometastatic prostate cancer, novel immunotherapeutic approaches, and the new era of artificial intelligence-driven precision medicine. DISCUSSION: This article provides an overview of the scientific presentations delivered at the 2023 CHPCA Meeting, such that this knowledge can help in facilitating the advancement of prostate cancer research worldwide.
abstract_zh: 引言：2023年Coffey-Holden前列腺癌学会（CHPCA）会议，主题为“颠覆前列腺癌研究：接受挑战”，于2023年6月22日至25日在加利福尼亚大学洛杉矶分校的Luskin会议中心召开。方法：2023年标志着第十届年度CHPCA会议，这是一个由前列腺癌基金会每年召集的、以讨论为导向的科学智库会议，聚焦于被认为对推进前列腺癌研究和临床护理中关键未满足需求至关重要的创新和新兴研究主题。2023年CHPCA会议有81位学术研究者参加，包括8个环节中的40场演讲。结果：会议涵盖的核心主题领域包括：靶向癌症中的转录因子新增强子体，AR作为促分化和致癌转录因子，为何少数患者通过雄激素剥夺疗法治愈，以及如何改变教条以无需去势治疗治愈转移性前列腺癌，通过遗传学降低前列腺癌发病率和死亡率，放射治疗在寡转移性前列腺癌中增强治疗益处的机会，新型免疫治疗方法，以及人工智能驱动的精准医疗新时代。讨论：本文概述了2023年CHPCA会议上的科学报告，以便这些知识有助于促进全球前列腺癌研究的进展。
